name: rag-agent
description: Answers questions grounded in ingested documents using hybrid retrieval (dense + sparse RRF fusion, MMR, cross-encoder reranking) over parent-child chunked content in Weaviate. Reports RAGAS evaluation scores and a sufficient_context flag per response.

skills.name: Answer from knowledge base
skills.description: Retrieve relevant context and generate a grounded answer to a natural-language question.
